mainEntity.name: What is the best Greek island for a honeymoon?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a single one, which is why this route has five. If I had to pick two, it's Santorini for three nights in a caldera pool suite, then Folegandros or Paros for the quiet. A full week on Santorini alone is the version I'd talk you out of.

mainEntity.name: Santorini or Mykonos for a honeymoon?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, in the right doses: two nights in Mykonos to land, three in Santorini for the caldera. If you can only do one, make it Santorini, in Oia, in a suite with its own pool.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Greece honeymoon cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This one, booked as written with pool suites and private transfers, runs roughly $26,000 to $34,000 for two for fourteen nights, excluding international flights. Ferries instead of private boats take $5,000 to $7,000 off, and entry-level rooms bring it down further.

mainEntity.name: How many days do you need for a honeymoon in Greece?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ten nights is the shortest version of this route I'd build, at four islands. Fourteen is the sweet spot, because no stop drops below two nights. With a week, do two islands well rather than four badly.

mainEntity.name: What is the best month for a honeymoon in Greece?

acceptedAnswer.text: Late May to mid-June, or the first three weeks of September. The sea is warm, the good tables are gettable, and the meltemi wind is far less likely to cancel a boat transfer than in July and August.

mainEntity.name: Is five islands in fourteen nights too many?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at this pace, because no stop is shorter than two nights and no transfer eats a day. What makes multi-island trips exhausting isn't the number of islands. It's ferry mornings. Remove those and five is comfortable.

mainEntity.name: How much do private transfers actually add?

acceptedAnswer.text: Across a route like this one, about $5,000 to $7,000 over the two weeks.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to start in Mykonos?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It's simply the easiest arrival airport and the softest landing. The route also works starting in Santorini and running the other direction.

mainEntity.name: Can this be done in ten nights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, at four islands. Cut Mykonos and fly straight to Paros, then run Paros–Sifnos–Santorini–Folegandros.

mainEntity.name: How far ahead should we book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nine to twelve months for June and September. The pool suites are the first to go.

headline: The Best Greece Honeymoon Itinerary: Five Islands, Fourteen Nights, Zero Ferries
description: The best Greek honeymoon I know how to build: five islands, fourteen nights, no ferries. The exact hotels, pool suites, costs and best months to go.
